name: Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals heaven as both God's holy dwelling place and the future home of the righteous, created by God at the beginning of time (Genesis 1:1; Nehemiah 9:6). It is from heaven that God watches over and blesses His people (Deuteronomy 26:15; Nehemiah 9:27), affirming His sovereign authority over all creation. The heavens are portrayed as the realm where God's glory is worshiped and where His faithful find ultimate refuge and blessing.
